about: Breaks a siege of one of your castles or towns: it waits where it is until strong enough, then strikes the besiegers. The garrison and any of your lords inside sally out to join the battle only when they and the relief together are more than 1.5 times the besiegers' strength (the game's rule; militia never sally), so the strength it weighs counts them only then. Best with an army, for example gather, then relieve.
calls_back: it strikes, it is still too weak to strike, the siege ends, or the holding falls

strike_at: strike when its strength (with the defenders inside, when they would sally out) is this many times the besiegers'
wait_hours: how long to wait for enough strength before giving up

when.poke: {me} is striking the besiegers of {at}: strength {relief_strength(at)} with the defenders inside who would sally out ({me}'s own {strength}) against {siege_strength(at)}.
{me} is too weak to strike the besiegers of {at} yet: strength {relief_strength(at)} with the defenders inside who would sally out ({me}'s own {strength}) against {siege_strength(at)}.

wait.about: waiting for the strength to relieve {at}

when.poke: {me} is striking the besiegers of {at}: strength {relief_strength(at)} with the defenders inside who would sally out ({me}'s own {strength}) against {siege_strength(at)}.
